title: Who Puts the “Social” in “Social Computing”?: Using A Neurodiversity Framing to Review Social Computing Research
reasoning: The paper is a systematic literature review focused on the representation and inclusion of neurodivergent individuals in social computing and HCI research. While it critiques the values and societal norms embedded in technology design (such as the medical model of disability), it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a primary subject.
